title: Chic Condo for 4 Near West End
description:
✔️ West End location — minutes to Downtown, Vanderbilt, and Broadway
✔️ Modern condo with city views
✔️ 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom — sleeps up to 4
✔️ King suite with smart TV and workspace
✔️ Full kitchen and in-home laundry
✔️ Garage parking for 1 vehicle and elevator access

The space
• Modern condominium designed for comfortable Nashville getaways
• Bright living room with a full-size foldaway bed and laptop-friendly workspace
• Full kitchen for easy meals at home
• King bedroom with smart TV and city views
• Perfect for couples, business travelers, solo travelers, and small groups

🌅 Indoor & Outdoor Living
• Open living area with comfortable seating
• City views
• Laptop-friendly workspace with high-speed WiFi
• Elevator access throughout the building

🛏️ Bedrooms & Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 4)
• This home includes 1 bedroom and 1 bathroom.
• Bedroom 1 — King bed; smart TV
• Living Room — Full-size foldaway bed (sleeps 2)
• Bath — Single vanity with stone countertop; shower/tub combo

🍳 Kitchen & Dining
• Full kitchen with basic cookware and serveware
• Full-size appliances
• Cookware, dishes, utensils, and glassware provided
• Salt, pepper, and cooking oil are not provided

🏖️ What's Included
• Private washer and dryer
• High-speed WiFi
• Laptop-friendly workspace
• Smart TV in the bedroom
• We provide bedding, towels, and a small starter set of essentials

📍 Location Highlights
• West End — close to restaurants, cafés, and nightlife
• Minutes to Downtown Nashville and Broadway
• Near Vanderbilt University
• Easy access to music venues, museums, and popular attractions

🚗 Parking, Safety & Notes
• Parking: Garage parking is available on a first-come, first-served basis for 1 vehicle per unit. Additional street parking is available as needed on a first-come basis. No additional on-site parking beyond what’s described.
• Elevator: Available in the building; maintenance and outages are managed by the HOA. In case of emergency, please use the stairs.
• This home is not pet friendly. If there is found evidence of an animal's presence during your stay or post check-out, guests will be charged an additional cleaning fee.
• Check in is at 4:00 PM and checkout is at 10:00 AM.
